findings.title: Too much text at once
findings.message: 1 occurrence: 3 text blocks, 6 words on screen
findings.fix: show one idea at a time: at most 2 text blocks and 18 words on screen together

findings.title: Invented vocabulary
findings.message: 1 occurrence: "BPM" isn't in the glossary, the brief or captured UI text
findings.fix: use the product's own words (.demovie/glossary.md), or add the term to the brief/glossary if it is real

findings.title: Invented numbers
findings.message: 4 occurrences: "00" isn't in the brief, the glossary or captured UI text
findings.fix: only show numbers from the brief, seed data or captures; put the source in the brief if it is real

findings.title: Blank frames
findings.message: 1 occurrence: frame is more than 98% one color
findings.fix: start content earlier, overlap shots with a transition, or add a background element

findings.title: "AI look" clichés
findings.message: 4 occurrences: timecode: "00:00:12:08 · 120 BPM"
findings.fix: drop decorative HUD/timecode labels and generic chips; stay with the brand's one or two typefaces

findings.title: Truthful cursor
findings.message: 1 occurrence: click without a target: call cursor.moveTo() before cursor.click()
findings.fix: move the cursor to the element (cursor.moveTo(screen, id)) so it arrives before the click, and click while the element is on screen

findings.title: Invented vocabulary
findings.message: 2 occurrences: "Quantum" isn't in the glossary, the brief or captured UI text
findings.fix: use the product's own words (.demovie/glossary.md), or add the term to the brief/glossary if it is real

findings.title: Product shots use captures
findings.message: 1 occurrence: product shot "fake" contains no screen()
findings.fix: show product UI only with screen(v, { capture: "<id>", parent: shot.el }) — never draw or mock it

findings.title: Invented numbers
findings.message: 1 occurrence: "47%" isn't in the brief, the glossary or captured UI text
findings.fix: only show numbers from the brief, seed data or captures; put the source in the brief if it is real

findings.title: Upscaled captures
findings.message: 1 occurrence: routes/app@desktop is shown at 3.07× its pixel density
findings.fix: zoom less, show the screen smaller, or capture at a higher deviceScaleFactor

findings.title: Blank frames
findings.message: 2 occurrences: frame is more than 98% one color
findings.fix: start content earlier, overlap shots with a transition, or add a background element

findings.title: Text stays on screen long enough to read
findings.message: 1 occurrence: "Plan every launch on one board" is readable for 0.5 s; 6 words need 2.5 s
findings.fix: hold the text longer (or cut words): give it at least 0.5 s + 1/3 s per word, and never less than 1.2 s

findings.title: Minimum text size
findings.message: 1 occurrence: "Projects board" is 18.0 px; minimum is 32.4 px
findings.fix: set the font size to at least 3% of the frame's short side (calc(var(--dm-unit) * 3)); captions need 3.8%

findings.title: No text overflow or clipping
findings.message: 1 occurrence: "Every launch from planning to launched" is overflowing its box
findings.fix: shorten the copy, let it wrap (max-width in ch), or enlarge the container so no glyph is cut

findings.title: Contrast
findings.message: 1 occurrence: "Velocity" contrast 1.48:1 (#d4d4d8 on ~#ffffff)
findings.fix: darken/lighten the text or its background (brand fg on bg), or put the text on a solid panel
